decision.comment: Validated 2026-08-31: NZ n=1 0.537 OVERRIDDEN -> CoFID 0.9 (18-396 lamb-specific, MW4-1978 heritage). Cardiac family runs 0.728-1.13 (chicken/turkey/beef; beef 0.906): cardiac muscle is mitochondria-dense and rumen synthesis makes B2 feed-independent, so the NZ single sample at half the mammalian band reads low. CoFID converges with the family from an independent lineage.
decision.resolution: Override keep-primary: family physiology + independent CoFID convergence at ~0.9 vs an n=1 primary at half the family floor - the heart-Zn override pattern, inverted direction. Approved by Shahab 2026-08-31.
